JustTools / Image Utilities - bundled libraries and model credits

All runtime assets are served from this app. Upstream addresses below are
attribution/source references, not runtime image-processing services.
Library sources and models are unmodified. The metadata adapter is bundled
locally as described below. Retain these notices and licenses.

MediaPipe Tasks Vision 1.2.3
Copyright Google LLC. Apache License 2.0.
https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe
License: mediapipe/LICENSE
BlazeFace full-range, float16, model version 1:
https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/face_detector
Model license: models/blaze_face_full_range.tflite.LICENSE.txt

U2Netp
U-2-Net by Xuebin Qin and the U-2-Net authors. Apache License 2.0.
https://github.com/xuebinqin/U-2-Net
ONNX checkpoint distributed by rembg:
https://github.com/danielgatis/rembg/releases/tag/v0.0.0
Model license: models/u2netp.onnx.LICENSE.txt
Preprocessing reference: rembg/sessions/base.py and rembg/sessions/u2netp.py
MD5: 8e83ca70e441ab06c318d82300c84806
SHA-256: 309c8469258dda742793dce0ebea8e6dd393174f89934733ecc8b14c76f4ddd8

ExifReader 4.54.0
Copyright Mattias Wallander and contributors. Mozilla Public License 2.0.
https://github.com/mattiasw/ExifReader
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/exifreader@4.54.0/
License: exifreader/LICENSE
Unmodified source files, extracted from the published source map with the
package's build configuration and license: exifreader/source.zip
The source map, with original source contents, is also included beside the
distribution file. ExifReader is a separate, unmodified library.

ExifTool 13.63 / ZeroPerl metadata runtime
ExifTool by Phil Harvey, distributed under the Artistic license option.
Perl 5.42.0, ZeroPerl, and the WebAssembly runtime have separate licenses.
The unmodified adapter and CLI from @colorhythm/exiftool-wasm 1.0.8 are
bundled with runtime-entry.js; the paired WASM binary is unchanged.
Complete credits and license/source references: exiftool/THIRD-PARTY.txt
Adapter source: exiftool/source.zip
Build/provenance: exiftool/BUILD.txt and exiftool/exiftool-build.json
